prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel art relic inventory atlas for an original cozy exploration game. A perfectly regular contact sheet with EXACTLY 3 columns and 5 rows, 15 equal square cells, edge-to-edge grid, each relic centered in its own cell, generous identical empty margins, no objects crossing cells. Dark solid forest-green background #162d28 throughout, no dividing lines. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, legible small silhouettes, cohesive retro fantasy inventory art, subtle 2-tone pixel shadow, no realistic rendering. Row 1: firefly lantern, mossy carved stone seal, four-leaf bookmark. Row 2: moon silver coin, blue crystal compass, echo seashell. Row 3: falling-star pendant, ancient brass astrolabe, luminous feather. Row 4: harvest copper bell, small windmill gear, golden wheat kite. Row 5: frost lantern wick in a tiny jar, icy lake prism, pine-snow badge. Each item unique and immediately recognizable. Strict front-facing small-object icons, view consistent. No text, digits, lettering, labels, watermarks, decorative frames or UI. Overall portrait sheet, width:height 3:5.
